Mitch Cantor decreased its stake in Cabot Oil & Gas Corp (COG) by 39.02% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Mountain Lake Investment Management Llc sold 80,000 shares as the company’s stock declined 13.77% with the market. The hedge fund run by Mitch Cantor held 125,000 shares of the oil & gas production company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $3.58 million, down from 205,000 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Mountain Lake Investment Management Llc who had been investing in Cabot Oil & Gas Corp for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $10.45 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 1.26% or $0.29 during the last trading session, reaching $22.67. About 4.95M shares traded. Cabot Oil & Gas Corporation (NYSE:COG) has risen 2.54% since May 14, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 9.01% the S&P500.
